articles.title: Seoul issues emergency alert for Ulleung Island after suspected Russian aircraft violates airspace
articles.description: The interior ministry on Tuesday sent an emergency alert for residents of Ulleung Island after a suspected Russian aircraft violated South Korea's airspace. The ministry issued the disaster message at 7:52 a.m., warning residents on the island in the East Sea to evacuate to underground facilities or inside buildings. North Gyeongsang Province lifted the alert five minutes later. The province said a suspected North Korean aircraft left the area in its message that lifted the alert.
